card.name: Digits inside ASCII code numbers
card.fires_on: Individual digits, often the first digit '1', inside numbers in programming or technical text such as ASCII code ranges (32 through 127), octal/hex conversions, IP addresses and hash values.

modes.description: A digit inside a number in terminal output, IP addresses or hashes.
